description: This file defines the EmailSubscriptionAPI class, a REST API endpoint for managing email subscriptions within an admin plugin of the OrangeHRM system. It provides methods for listing, updating, and managing email subscription data, including pagination and sorting.

classes.name: EmailSubscriptionAPI
classes.description: Defines API endpoints for listing and updating email subscription records in the admin module, implementing CRUD operations with validation and pagination.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated and sortable list of email subscriptions, returning the data along with total count.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for creating new email subscriptions.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for retrieving a specific email subscription.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the 'enabled' status of a specific email subscription identified by ID.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Not implemented; intended for deleting email subscriptions.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Returns validation rules for the 'getAll' method, primarily for sorting and pagination parameters.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForCreate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for creating an email subscription (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Returns validation rules for retrieving a single email subscription (not implemented).

methods.name: getValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Returns validation rules for updating an email subscription, requiring an ID and 'enabled' boolean.
